description: List all certificates with paging (Certificate Manager 2.0). For a plain inventory prefer ncloud_list_certificates (1.0, works with any key); this one adds page/pageSize and the 2.0 response fields (certificate type, status, order). Public zone only. Works with main-account and Sub Account keys (Sub Account verified 2026-11-25; earlier the 2.0 API rejected Sub Account keys with HTTP 403).

certificateName.description: Restrict results to this certificate name

name: ncloud_cm2_list_certificates
